# Toolkit Lab

> Toolkit Lab is a free website with 43 browser-based tools for PDFs, images, video audio, calculators and text, plus practical guides. Files are processed on the user's device and are not uploaded.

## Tools
- [Merge PDF](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/merge-pdf.html): combine PDF files in any order
- [Split PDF](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/split-pdf.html): extract selected pages from a PDF
- [Rotate PDF](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/rotate-pdf.html): rotate all pages by 90, 180 or 270 degrees
- [JPG and PNG to PDF](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/image-to-pdf.html): one image per PDF page
- [PDF to JPG](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/pdf-to-jpg.html): save each PDF page as a JPG
- [Image Compressor](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/image-compressor.html): shrink JPEG, PNG and WebP files
- [Image Resizer](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/image-resizer.html): resize images and aim for a target file size
- [Image Converter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/image-converter.html): convert between JPG, PNG and WebP
- [PSD to PNG / JPG](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/psd-converter.html): convert Photoshop files
- [Video to MP3](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/video-to-mp3.html): extract audio from a video file on your device
- [Loan EMI Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/loan-calculator.html): monthly payment and total interest
- [BMI Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/bmi-calculator.html): body mass index
- [Percentage Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/percentage-calculator.html)
- [Date Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/date-calculator.html): days between dates
- [Age Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/age-calculator.html): exact age in years, months and days
- [Unit Converter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/unit-converter.html): length, weight and temperature
- [Word Counter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/word-counter.html)
- [Case Converter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/case-converter.html)
- [JSON Formatter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/json-formatter.html)
- [Base64 Encoder](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/base64.html)
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/lorem-ipsum-generator.html)
- [Hash Generator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/hash-generator.html): SHA-256, SHA-512 and more
- [Password Generator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/password-generator.html)
- [QR Code Generator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/qr-code-generator.html)
- [Color Converter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/color-converter.html): HEX, RGB and HSL
- [Text Diff Checker](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/text-diff-checker.html): compare two texts line by line
- [Discount Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/discount-calculator.html): sale price, savings and tax
- [Tip Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/tip-calculator.html): tip, total and split between people
- [Random Number Generator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/random-number-generator.html): random numbers in a range
- [URL Encoder and Decoder](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/url-encoder.html): percent-encode and decode text
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/compound-interest-calculator.html): savings growth over time
- [SIP Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/sip-calculator.html): monthly investment growth
- [GST Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/gst-calculator.html): add or remove GST
- [Unix Timestamp Converter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/unix-timestamp-converter.html): epoch time and dates
- [URL Slug Generator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/url-slug-generator.html): clean URL slugs from titles
- [Roman Numeral Converter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/roman-numeral-converter.html)
- [Regex Tester](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/regex-tester.html): test regular expressions
- [Typing Speed Test](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/typing-speed-test.html): words per minute and accuracy
- [Image to Base64](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/image-to-base64.html): data URI for small images
- [CSV to JSON Converter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/csv-to-json.html): turn CSV into JSON
- [Markdown Preview](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/markdown-preview.html): see Markdown formatted
- [Password Strength Checker](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/password-strength-checker.html): estimate password strength on your device
- [Online Stopwatch](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/stopwatch.html)
